protocol.training_policy: 768 distinct 1..3-digit signed single-operation tasks with fixed balanced add/sub/mul cycle. Teacher traces only for training. Held local contexts receive no loss and no memory entry; their input exposure/next-state teacher-forcing indirect exposure are disclosed and counted. No evaluation identity/answer selects a task or checkpoint. Fixed final update800 only.
protocol.controls: Same numeric model parameters, targets, features and updates for recurrent vs reset-hidden; difference is temporal state retention, so historical-information access differs intentionally. Exact training-context memory only, no synthesis; zero weights without memory; zero weights plus same exact memory. Exact sign-memory retrieval only when original a,b,op match, otherwise sign0. Independent Python integer reference and symbolic families are separate tool results.
protocol.decision: Any data/engineering/integrity gate failure: stop DATA_NO_GO/FAILED_CAMPAIGN before further training. Numeric gates fail: NO_GO. All numeric and integrity gates pass: GO_TO_CONFIRMATION only. No altered thresholds,extra fits,budgets,seeds or hidden lockbox reads.
protocol.scaffold: Decimal place-value iteration,signed-magnitude normalization/ordering,grade-school partial-product scheduling,decimal serialization are supplied and identical across controls. Numeric digit/carry and sign outputs remain neural and uncorrected. No exact legal-action masks,teacher query,arithmetic raw sum/product feature or verifier feedback in inference. This is learned numeric transitions within an explicit algorithmic scaffold,not autonomous discovery of arithmetic algorithms.
protocol.coverage: Neural signed integer add/sub/mul bounded to40 output digits and4096 transitions. Division is independently assessed symbolic Euclidean quotient/remainder only. Fractions,elementary algebra,equations,matrices,coordinate geometry,basic calculus and probability/statistics are bounded symbolic/tool families with distinct method labels,never counted as neural performance.
protocol.uncertainty: 24 independent tasks/family shared across three seeds; report per-seed counts,Wilson intervals for each seed,failure distributions and local-context seen/unseen splits. Repeated seed evaluations do not increase independent task count. No confirmatory inference from small exploratory comparisons.
